native_pin_outcomes.complete: Known Java-visible native feature roots filtered by retained result CIDs. Opaque native semantics are not claimed.
native_pin_outcomes.incomplete_ids: Remove known rejected CIDs, retain unclassified native points. List filtering stays effective.
native_pin_outcomes.no_native_intersection: When accepted rows exist but all native points would be removed, preserve original native metadata; keep filtered lists.
native_pin_outcomes.confirmed_empty: No accepted candidate rows: retain an explicit empty native result list and remove rejected selected roots.
native_pin_outcomes.unsupported_native_shape: Keep original native metadata, keep filtered lists.
native_pin_outcomes.diagnostics: Complete filter failure and partial native filtering have distinct bounded query-free diagnostics.
